rationale: Corrects 20261106-gpu-runtime-device-forward-exports, whose rationale said these changes stay inert in Vellum's mirror as long as Vellum never defines PULP_GPU_RUNTIME for mirrored sources. That holds only until the next re-export. Each path gains a PULP_GPU_RUNTIME forwarding branch with its original body kept under #else, or takes its forward declarations from pulp/platform/gpu_fwd.hpp; gpu_runtime_hooks.cpp and gpu_fwd.hpp are new. Before the next re-export Vellum keeps today's blobs. The re-export carries these bytes together with gpu_fwd.hpp, and its closures carry PULP_GPU_RUNTIME=1 from pulp-platform's interface, so Vellum's mirror then compiles the forwarding branch against its in-tree gpu-runtime (vellum#212, vellum#216). The inheritance decision is unchanged: vellum_inherits stays true.
